powerLawBased.policy: Published full-law coefficients unchanged; no test fitting.

secondaryHarmonic.reference_input: Matched solid anchor factors are physical model inputs; no perforated prospective response may be used to alter coefficients
secondaryHarmonic.evaluation_rule: Evaluate unchanged on all ten registered layouts; compare with exponential6 using identical global harmonic targets, five mixtures, all layouts and registered 10% P95 ceiling
secondaryHarmonic.role: Secondary static formulation frozen before prospective FE response generation. Original six-layout outcomes are exposed development diagnostics, not fresh evaluation.
